sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

The core gameplay mechanics of 'Rolling Speed Ball' are simple yet effective. The game is all about navigating a rolling ball through challenging tracks filled with obstacles, sharp turns, and thrilling surprises as you race toward the finish line. The controls are straightforward, where you can use your mouse or tap on the screen to navigate the ball. The game also features a variety of power-ups and boosters that can help you navigate the track more efficiently. These power-ups can give you a temporary speed boost, increase your ball's size to avoid obstacles, or even reverse the direction of the track. With these power-ups, you'll be able to overcome even the most challenging obstacles and reach the finish line in record time.

One of the key challenges in 'Rolling Speed Ball' is mastering the timing of your movements.
